subject.title: fix(android): show conversation in screenshot fixture

question: Should the maintainer-labelled PR wait for final-head Android screenshot-script proof before merge?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically sound, but the only visual evidence predates the commit that changes the automation readiness marker, so accepting the existing prototype as equivalent is a maintainer merge-gate judgment.

options.title: Request final-head proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Android screenshot plus terminal or live output showing the final branch reaches and captures the seeded chat scene.

options.title: Accept the prototype evidence
options.body: Merge based on the equivalent temporary fixture screenshot and focused automated coverage, accepting that the final capture-script path was not shown.

recommendation.title: Request final-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Android screenshot plus terminal or live output showing the final branch reaches and captures the seeded chat scene.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently implemented both the related Android reader work and this fixture/readiness update.
